releaseNotes: The offline setup / update window is now built in the background while the seven-second splash screen is visible and appears the moment the splash ends, with no lag. When the installed package is current nothing is shown.

Updates download only the changed files into a staging area, verify every one (size + SHA-256) and only then swap them in, so the installed app is never left half old and half new. A Restart button applies the update.
The window can always be postponed with Later; a slow or missing connection can no longer lock the student out of the app. The server check times out after four seconds.
The saved package list is no longer overwritten before an update finishes, so an unfinished update cannot break offline launch.
Question-bank data now comes only from the verified offline package, so updated questions appear immediately instead of one launch later.
The app no longer reloads itself in the middle of studying; updates are applied only from the update window.
Review/audit files that the app never opens are no longer part of the offline download (about 2.7 MB smaller).
